protocol: Fresh samples generated by bench/x53/blind-gen.ts and blind-gen2.ts (visible: contract + reduced; hidden: original). The assistant decoded by hand from the visible message only (positional discipline: header word anchors transcribed first, per-field end positions computed, checked against fitted gaps), committed each decode to bench/x53/blind/decode/ via a write_file call, and only then compared with cmp. No code was used to produce the decodes.

results.source: live `ps aux` in sandbox, header + rows 40..63 (24 rows)
results.note: First attempt. Process caveat: the comparison bash ran in the same tool block as the decode write and a failed cmp leaked the first 9 original lines into the transcript AFTER the decode content had been fixed in the preceding write_file call; rows 10-25 were never seen. T3 re-decoded many of the same rows independently.

results.source: synthetic df-formula table on real df geometry (bench/x53/blind-gen2.ts, seed 0xB2, 14 rows; provenance: formula-generated, labelled synthetic)
results.rule: ceilShare Used/(Used+Available) with % suffix; includes 8-digit Used values that push the Used column one space right
results.note: First attempt. 14 ceiling divisions computed by hand.

results.source: bench/x53/fixtures/ps-bigmem.txt rows 30..79 (50 rows; real ps incl. overflow VSZ row 1229, wide-RSS row 4457, %CPU 99.5 anchor edge, and a ~1.4k-char COMMAND)
results.note: Reader-endurance quantification (X52 task 1): 50 rows x 11 fields decoded byte-exactly in one pass. Nonzero %MEM divisions: 8048->0.1, 8764->0.2, 8980->0.2, 20408->0.5, 269296->6.6, 10364->0.2. This is n=1 reader (the assistant) with explicit positional discipline; it demonstrates contract sufficiency, not ease. Contrast DIPTYCHON blind round 1 (0/4) where gutter dot-counting failed; TAXIS fields are short tokens placed by explicit anchors, which proved robust here.

pythonCrossDecode: bench/x53/taxis_decode.py decoded all 6 emitted (contract, reduced) pairs in bench/x53/tmp-cross byte-exactly, parsing aligns/gaps/rules from the contract text alone.
